summary: This is an 8-K filing by AGL Private Credit Income Fund reporting three items: (i) a routine capital call drawdown closing on June 26, 2026, under which 1,289,767.84 common shares were sold for $30 million in aggregate ($23.26 per share) to accredited investors via Section 4(a)(2) / Regulation D—this is a normal ongoing capital raise for a BDC/closed-end fund, not a special situation; (ii) disclosure of recent portfolio investments totaling $102.5 million at a 5.3% weighted-average spread; and (iii) a regular distribution declaration. No transaction, strategic review, or event meeting special-situations criteria is present.
